messages:
Amara Diallo: anyone else seeing RBAC v2 role changes not taking effect right away in staging? Support pinged that a user was added to Billing Admin but still got 403 for ~20m. Smells like policy cache stale.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: yep, I can repro. Steps:
1) add user to role in console
2) immediately hit `POST /v1/billing/invoices/export`
3) still getting `403 rbac_denied` until ~TTL expires

Jordan Lee: do we have a request log w/ the authz debug fields? specifically role_ids + policy_version + cache hit.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: from control-plane logs (staging) w/ debug on:
```
service=control-plane route=POST /v1/billing/invoices/export org_id=org_2k9 actor=user_8a2
rbac_v2.cache=hit rbac_v2.cache_key=rbac:policy:org_2k9 rbac_v2.cache_age_ms=1184321
rbac_v2.policy_version=v0.1.7 rbac_v2.role_ids=[role_dev_readonly]
rbac_v2.decision=deny rbac_v2.reason=missing_permission billing.invoice.export
```
Then after ~20m:
```
rbac_v2.cache=miss rbac_v2.role_ids=[role_billing_admin]
rbac_v2.decision=allow
```

Benji Okafor: cache_key looks like the *policy bundle* per-org cache (policy + role bindings snapshot), right? do we invalidate that on role assignment writes?

Kaitlyn Nguyen: I think only on policy bundle update / org config change. Role assignment uses `PUT /v1/orgs/{id}/role-assignments` and that path does not call invalidation.

Ethan Park: :facepalm: that would do it. Our cache was meant to be “policy eval inputs” which includes bindings. If bindings update doesn’t bust, we’re effectively relying on TTL.

Jordan Lee: can someone link the code path? I remember PR 18477 added invalidation but maybe only for bundle changes.

Benji Okafor: found it. In `authz/cache.go`:
```
func (c *Cache) GetPolicySnapshot(ctx, orgID string) (*Snapshot, error) {
  // cached: policy bundle + role assignments + group mappings
  // key: rbac:policy:<org>
}

func (c *Cache) Invalidate(ctx, orgID string, reason string) error {
  // called from /v1/orgs/:id/policy-bundle and /v1/orgs/:id/sso
}
```
Role assignment handler (`role_assignments.go`) writes to DB and returns 204, no cache touch.

Allison Grant: if we’re going to rely on invalidation, we should also emit a metric for “stale read detected” or at least cache age at decision time. Otherwise hard to debug.

Jordan Lee: +1. We need two things:
1) correctness fix: invalidate on any mutation to role bindings / group mapping
2) observability: invalidations_total w/ reason + cache_age_seconds on reads + maybe “shadow mismatch” if DB says role differs

Leila Farouk: can we add a deterministic test? e2e-ish: assign role -> immediately call endpoint -> expect allow. This will fail today if cache hit.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: yep. I can add integration test in control-plane test harness that forces cache to prime, then updates role assignment, then checks request sees new role_ids.

Connor O'Brien: does this impact prod? we’ve had caching on in Hosted behind the flag but not enforcing yet, right?

Ethan Park: prod is in dual-eval/shadow for most routes. But stale cache will pollute shadow-deny metrics and freak us out during rollout.

Amara Diallo: also explains the weird “shadow deny spikes after admin changes roles” we saw last week.

Jordan Lee: proposal:
- in `PUT/DELETE role-assignments`, call `authzCache.Invalidate(orgID, reason="role_assignment_change")`
- same for SSO group mapping updates (already there?)
- add metrics:
  - `rbac_v2_cache_invalidation_total{reason}`
  - `rbac_v2_cache_get_total{result=hit|miss}`
  - `rbac_v2_cache_entry_age_seconds` histogram (observe on hit)
  - `rbac_v2_policy_eval_latency_ms` already exists

Benji Okafor: SSO mapping path calls invalidation today, but only at org-level SSO config. If group->role mapping is separate endpoint, we should make sure both paths invalidate.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: there’s also “direct user role assignment” and “service account role assignment”. Both should invalidate.

Allison Grant: please include a log field for invalidation reason when it happens, at least at info level:
`rbac_v2.cache_invalidate org_id=... reason=...`
And for reads: log cache_age_ms only when > threshold to avoid noise.

Jordan Lee: good call. We can do sampling or “only if age > 60s” for debug.

Grafana: Alert (staging): rbac_v2_shadow_denies increased above threshold in last 15m. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/staging/d/rbac-shadow-denies

Amara Diallo: ^ this is exactly what I meant :)

Kaitlyn Nguyen: quick mitigation: temporarily lower TTL in staging from 30m -> 1m so we stop flapping while fix lands?

Ethan Park: ok for staging, but I’d rather not churn prod config unless needed. Let’s ship invalidation fix ASAP.

Benji Okafor: I can put up a PR today w/ invalidation calls in the role assignment handlers. Need to make sure it doesn’t introduce extra latency on write path (should be a single redis DEL).

Jordan Lee: for Private/offline installs, invalidation still local in-process or local redis, so fine.

Leila Farouk: for tests, how do we ensure we’re actually hitting cache? can we expose a “prime cache” helper or just call once to populate.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: easiest is:
- call protected endpoint as read-only user (populates cache)
- update assignment
- call endpoint again and assert roles changed in authz debug headers (we can enable debug headers in test env)

Connor O'Brien: add to rollout notes: “role changes should take effect <5s” and add a canary check maybe.

Allison Grant: +1. Also consider a metric for invalidation lag if we ever move to async invalidation events.

Jordan Lee: we can keep it synchronous for now. If we move to pubsub later, metric can be `rbac_v2_cache_invalidation_delay_ms`.

deploybot: Benji Okafor opened PR #18512: "RBAC v2: invalidate policy snapshot cache on role assignment changes" (staging)

Benji Okafor: PR up. Adds invalidation on:
- POST/PUT/DELETE user role assignment
- service account role assignment
- bulk role assignment
Also adds metrics scaffolding (counter + cache_age histogram). Would love review from @Jordan and @Allison.

Jordan Lee: looking now. Can you also include “reason” label as low-cardinality enum (no org_id label pls)?

Benji Okafor: yep, labels are just `reason=role_assignment_change|policy_bundle_update|sso_mapping_change`.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: I’ll add the integration test in a follow-up PR unless you want it in the same one.

Ethan Park: same PR is ideal but if it slows merge, do follow-up today/tomorrow. The invalidation fix is the urgent bit.

Allison Grant: reviewed metrics bits — looks good. One request: rename `rbac_v2_cache_entry_age_seconds` to `rbac_v2_policy_snapshot_cache_age_seconds` to be explicit.

Benji Okafor: done.

Amara Diallo: once this is merged, I can re-run the repro and close the loop w/ support. thanks all.

Jordan Lee: merged w/ minor nits. Let’s watch shadow deny dashboard after deploy. If it still spikes, next suspect is cache invalidation not firing for group-based assignments.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: yep, will double-check group mapping endpoints and add coverage.

Connor O'Brien: please drop a note in #eng-releases once staging looks clean so we don’t block next enforcement ramp.
